text:
maria-gonzalez: Heads up - new onboarding sample app hits a weird stalled request on Android 13 when running behind an ADB http proxy. Retrofit call never returns, but server sees the request reach it and then nothing.

maria-gonzalez: Stack trace is just hanging inside OkHttp's exchange, no 401 or retry loop. Works fine on simulator without proxy.

maria-gonzalez: Repro steps: `adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080` -> start sample -> hit /health -> hangs. Tried disabling interceptors, same behavior.

daniel-cho: hmm. Could be cleartext/redirect policy or TLS downgrade when proxying. Android 9+ blocks cleartext by default unless networkSecurityConfig allows it.

maria-gonzalez: It's HTTPS on the server, but the ADB proxy rewrites to http locally. On-device -> https -> proxy -> http. Emulator works because it has different network stack.

jess-b: Quick try: set OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(false). Also add `.connectionPool(new ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))` to see if pooling is masking a stale socket.

samir: Also ensure call timeout is set, otherwise streaming requests can hang forever in some OkHttp versions. Example we used:```java
OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .callTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .readTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) // streaming
  .build();
```

samir: For Retrofit add `.client(client)` then test.

maria-gonzalez: Tried callTimeout, still hangs but now returns after ~30s with EOFException. Progress.

daniel-cho: EOF after timeout suggests proxy closes connection mid-exchange. You can try forcing TLS when talking to proxy by setting ConnectionSpec. Example: `.connectionSpecs(Collections.singletonList(ConnectionSpec.MODERN_TLS))`. But if proxy downgrades to http it will fail.

jess-b: Another angle: Android's Network Security Config can explicitly allow cleartext for the sample app - add `android:usesCleartextTraffic=\"true\"` to manifest or `network_security_config` to whitelist localhost. That often explains emulator vs device differences.

maria-gonzalez: Added usesCleartextTraffic=true, still reproduces. Suspect socket pooling + proxy rewrite race.

samir: Could be OkHttp bug with proxy tunneling and HTTP/2 prior knowledge. Try disabling http2 with `Protocol.HTTP_1_1` only.

maria-gonzalez: Will try. If we get a reliable repro I can add a tiny sample repo for DX team. Current workaround is to instruct users to run the sample without `adb reverse` and use a local VPN - but that's bad onboarding friction.

daniel-cho: If you can produce a 2-file repro (sample app + small Python proxy) that runs on-device and reproduces, we can file an upstream OkHttp bug and patch SDK docs with explicit ADB proxy caveat.

ci-bot: CI: reproduced test run created: https://ci.internal/repro/1718459991-1 (logs attached).

maria-gonzalez: Thanks all - I'll assemble minimal repro and ping here once uploaded. For immediate docs: add a note about ADB/http proxies + cleartext/TLS mismatches and callTimeout recommendations in the Android onboarding guide.

jess-b: Agreed. Also include snippet to detect proxy at runtime and warn user if detected (`System.getProperty(\"http.proxyHost\")` / `ConnectivityManager` heuristics).

samir: One last tip: for SDK parity tests, include an integration test on a physical device using a dockerized proxy. Catches these platform-specific flakiness early.
